name: Full ERP for a regulated trade

mentions.name: Full ERP for a regulated trade
mentions.description: This project implements a full-featured ERP for a complicated regulated trade, overhauling a SaaS that has been in business 15 years without a major overhaul, with big room identified for improving and simplifying the process.
mentions.problem: The SaaS has been in business 15 years without a major overhaul, and the process has big room for improvement and simplification.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was also laid off at the start of this year (again) and currently implementing a full blown ERP for a complicated regulated trade. It is worth it for them but I can see big room for improvement and simplifying the process. The SaaS has been in business 15years and hasn't had a major overhaul in a while
